titles.zh: 始平公造像记（古阳洞北壁）
titles.en: The Shiping Gong dedication on the north wall of Guyang Cave

productionDate.note: The exhibition notice dates the carving to 498; the date line on the stone is partly damaged.

currentCollection.note: Both sources place the dedication on the north wall of Guyang Cave on the west hill at Longmen. Neither describes its height above the floor, its shelter or its present legibility.
currentCollection.noteZh: 两处来源均记此刻在龙门西山古阳洞北壁。未记距地高度、保护设施与现存字口状况。

review.note: Draft object record from two illustrated features read on 2026-11-23. The rock face has not been measured in any cited source, so dimensions stay empty; the inscription was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的两篇图文材料整理。所引来源均未测量石面，故尺寸从缺；未核对原刻。

notes: The only measurement available is the rubbing's (89 × 39 cm, Longmen research institute collection); it is not used as the stone's size.
The relief carving means a rubbing reads as white characters on black, the reverse of an incised inscription; the record does not reproduce any impression.
No provenance event is recorded: the inscription has remained in the cave, and the cited sources describe no removal.
notesZh: 现有唯一尺寸为拓片纸幅（八十九×三十九厘米，龙门石窟研究院藏），不作石面尺寸使用。
阳刻拓本呈黑底白字，与阴刻相反；本记录不复制任何拓片。
不设递藏事件：此刻一直在洞中，所引来源未见移出记载。
